news.get_headlines

Retrieves news headlines.

Available as lseg.data.news.get_headlines.

get_headlines(
    query: str,
    count: int = 10,
    start: OptDateTime = None,
    end: OptDateTime = None,
    order_by: str | SortOrder = SortOrder.new_to_old,
) -> DataFrame

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
query str Yes The user search query for news headlines.
count int No 10 Count to limit number of headlines.
start OptDateTime No None Beginning of date range. String format is: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'. e.g. '2016-01-20T15:04:05'.
end OptDateTime No None End of date range. String format is: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'. e.g. '2016-01-20T15:04:05'.
order_by str | SortOrder No SortOrder.new_to_old Sort order for headline items.

Returns

pd.DataFrame

Headlines dataframe

Example

from datetime import timedelta
import lseg.data as ld
response = ld.news.get_headlines(
    "Refinitiv",
    start="20.03.2021",
    end=timedelta(days=-4),
    count=3
)

Related types

SortOrder

Sort order of news headlines: from oldest to newest or from newest to oldest.

Name Value Description
SortOrder.new_to_old 'newToOld'
SortOrder.old_to_new 'oldToNew'
